description: LifePRO dividend history -> QLAdmin QuikBenh benefit types 1-5. Layer A loads real PACTG dividend election transactions; Layer B adds one conversion adjustment row per policy for the pre-extract remainder so each policy ties to PPBENTYP.DIVIDENDS_CREDITED.
emit_side_note: The dividend is credited to the policy on the DEBIT leg (debit 0517 / credit 0112 buys paid-up additions; debit 0515 / credit 0096 pays cash). The same code on the CREDIT leg is the contra side - either the clearing half of a posting already captured on its debit leg, or a reversal DATE_REVERSED did not flag. Emitting both legs double-counts the dividend. Contra rows go to the exception report as CONTRA_SIDE_NOT_EMITTED.
accumulation_note: Issue #117. QLAdmin Help 6.5 p.649: MBENTYP 6 = 'Interest on policy funds / dividend accumulation', MBENTYP 7 = 'Surrendered dividend accumulations'. The Dividend History window is a full ledger, not a credits list: sum(3) + sum(6) - sum(7) equals the QuikDvdp balance in its footer. Verified on 425 of 464 accumulate policies in the client's production QUIKBENH.DBF. Interest enters the accumulation as debit 0641 / credit 0310; money leaves as debit 0310 against any counterparty (0038 death clearing, 0013 surrender clearing, 0012).
accumulation_contra_note: A debit-0310 posting reversed by a matching credit-0310 entry under a non-dividend debit code nets to zero and must not be emitted as a type 7, or the ledger understates the balance. Matched on exact amount within a policy. Reported as ACCUM_CONTRA_NETTED.

pactg_excluded_codes.0562: Surrender-PUA - surrender of dividend-purchased value, not a dividend credited
pactg_excluded_codes.0563: Surrender-OYT - surrender of dividend-purchased value, not a dividend credited
pactg_excluded_codes.0117: Dividend Accumulations Buy PUA - premium-side counterparty
pactg_excluded_codes.0112: Single Premium Paid-Up Additions - premium-side counterparty of 0517

lifetime_excluded_type_codes.OR: Rider rows carry dividends on a small number of policies; excluded to match the Issue #21F premium treatment. Logged to exceptions.

unmapped_option_notes.6: LifePRO Reduce Loan (Product Book 12-263). QLAdmin has no dividend-to-loan benefit type; nearest is 12, owned by Issue #54. Withheld to exceptions pending client answer (OQ-1).
unmapped_option_notes.blank: No dividend option recorded; benefit type not derivable. Withheld to exceptions (OQ-3).

accumulation_opening_note: The 20171231 opening is split so the ledger foots. The type 3 component is DIVIDENDS_CREDITED minus in-window credits - arithmetically identical to the Issue #114 plug, so that reconciliation is preserved. The type 6 component is the residual pre-2018 interest that makes sum(3)+sum(6)-sum(7) equal ACCUM_DIVIDENDS. Only emitted for policies whose dividend option maps to MBENTYP 3. A negative residual means value left the account before the PACTG window and is withheld to exceptions as ACCUM_OPENING_SHORTFALL (OQ-1).
